2609.05938.title: SurveyAgent-HKA: A multi-agent framework for scientific survey generation with LLMs and human knowledge augmentation
2609.05938.paper_summary: Automatic scientific survey generation has become an important task in scientific document processing. The common approach of retrieving literature from a single source (e.g., arXiv) and generating surveys through a one-pass large language model (LLM) call often leads to limited reference coverage and, more importantly, fails to replicate the expert-driven revision process that is crucial for writing high-quality surveys. In this paper, we introduce SurveyAgent-HKA, a multi-agent framework that improves end-to-end scientific survey generation by incorporating knowledge derived from published surveys and peer-review comments. The framework decomposes survey generation into well-defined sub-tasks handled by LLM-powered agent. It first retrieves relevant papers from multiple sources and identifies key topics through clustering to construct an initial outline, which is then refined using outlines from related human-written surveys. Based on the refined outline, topic-focused papers are retrieved and re-ranked to select for drafting a well-grounded survey. Then, we identify common issues raised by experts in peer-review comments from published surveys to guide the revisions and finalize the survey. Experiments on two domains show that our approach outperforms mainstream baselines in citation quality, structural consistency, and content quality. Furthermore, our framework is efficient in both time and cost, making it a practical solution for broader AI-assisted scientific writing applications.
2609.05938.paper_summary_zh: 自動科學調查生成已成為科學文件處理中的一項重要任務。從單一來源（例如，arXiv）檢索文獻並通過一次性的大型語言模型（LLM）調用生成調查的常見方法，往往導致參考文獻的覆蓋範圍有限，更重要的是，無法複製對於撰寫高品質調查至關重要的專家驅動修訂過程。在本文中，我們介紹了SurveyAgent-HKA，一個多代理框架，通過整合來自已發表調查和同行評審意見的知識來改善端到端的科學調查生成。該框架將調查生成分解為由LLM驅動的代理處理的明確子任務。它首先從多個來源檢索相關論文，並通過聚類識別關鍵主題以構建初步大綱，然後使用相關人類撰寫的調查的大綱進行細化。根據細化後的大綱，檢索以主題為重點的論文並重新排序，以選擇草擬一份有根據的調查。然後，我們從已發表調查的同行評審意見中識別專家提出的共同問題，以指導修訂並最終確定調查。對兩個領域的實驗表明，我們的方法在引用質量、結構一致性和內容質量方面超越了主流基準。此外，我們的框架在時間和成本上都很高效，使其成為更廣泛的AI輔助科學寫作應用的實用解決方案。
